requirements.claim: SSGC:2024 clause 4.3 sets the ultimate limit state wind action combination factor at a recommended psi_w = 1.4, applied to both pressure and suction, unless a National Annex specifies a different value for the project location.

For projects in Region Q the National Annex clause NA.4.3 replaces the recommended value and requires psi_w = 1.5 for the ultimate limit state; the Terminal Q project is stated to be in Region Q, so psi_w = 1.5 governs.
applicability_conditions: The National Annex value applies only because the question context places the project in Region Q.

verification_procedure.action: Confirm the project location is within Region Q so that the National Annex clause NA.4.3 applies.
Apply psi_w = 1.5 to the characteristic wind action for ultimate limit state load combinations on the curtain wall framing.

conflicts.description: SSGC:2024 clause 4.3 recommends psi_w = 1.4 while National Annex clause NA.4.3 requires psi_w = 1.5 for Region Q. The National Annex value governs for this project.
